cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(sh3_pluto_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
option(SH3_WITH_SVG "Also test PlutoSVG and FreeType integration" OFF)

if(NOT SH3_VG_CONFIG_DIR OR NOT EXISTS "${SH3_VG_CONFIG_DIR}/plutovgConfig.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_VG_CONFIG_DIR to the explicit PlutoVG package")
endif()
set(plutovg_DIR "${SH3_VG_CONFIG_DIR}")
find_package(plutovg 1.3.2 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED PATHS "${SH3_VG_CONFIG_DIR}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)

add_executable(sh3_vg_fixture vg.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sh3_vg_fixture PRIVATE plutovg::plutovg)
target_compile_features(sh3_vg_fixture PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(sh3_vg_fixture PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
enable_testing()
foreach(case IN ITEMS raster composite guards bounds)
    add_test(NAME plutovg-${case} COMMAND sh3_vg_fixture ${case})
    set_tests_properties(plutovg-${case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
endforeach()

if(SH3_WITH_SVG)
    if(NOT SH3_SVG_CONFIG_DIR OR NOT EXISTS "${SH3_SVG_CONFIG_DIR}/plutosvgConfig.cmake")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_SVG_CONFIG_DIR to the explicit PlutoSVG package")
    endif()
    if(NOT SH3_FONT OR NOT EXISTS "${SH3_FONT}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_FONT to the generated own SVG font")
    endif()
    if(NOT SH3_PREFIX OR NOT EXISTS "${SH3_PREFIX}/lib/libfreetype.dylib")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_PREFIX to the private FreeType installation")
    endif()
    set(FREETYPE_LIBRARY_RELEASE "${SH3_PREFIX}/lib/libfreetype.dylib")
    set(FREETYPE_INCLUDE_DIR_ft2build "${SH3_PREFIX}/include/freetype2")
    set(FREETYPE_INCLUDE_DIR_freetype2 "${SH3_PREFIX}/include/freetype2")
    find_package(Freetype 2.14.3 EXACT REQUIRED)
    set(plutosvg_DIR "${SH3_SVG_CONFIG_DIR}")
    find_package(plutosvg 0.0.7 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED PATHS "${SH3_SVG_CONFIG_DIR}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
    add_executable(sh3_svg_fixture svg.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sh3_svg_fixture PRIVATE plutosvg::plutosvg)
    target_compile_features(sh3_svg_fixture PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
    target_compile_options(sh3_svg_fixture PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
    foreach(case IN ITEMS render ids invalid freetype)
        add_test(NAME plutosvg-${case} COMMAND sh3_svg_fixture ${case}
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scene.svg" "${SH3_FONT}")
        set_tests_properties(plutosvg-${case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
    endforeach()
endif()
